## Analysis overview

Combines chemistry and hematology, standardizes test and visit order, counts baseline-to-analysis normal-range shifts by visit and treatment, and formats counts and percentages.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADLBC`
- `ADLBH`
- `ADSL`

## Key ADaM variables

- `PARAM`: laboratory parameter
- `VISIT/AVISITN`: visit
- `BNRIND`: baseline normal-range indicator
- `ANRIND`: analysis normal-range indicator
- `ABLFL`: baseline-record flag
- `SAFFL`: safety flag
- `TRTP`: planned treatment.
